title: 1vs1
description: 1v1 PvP arena plugin with ranking system, spectator betting, and emerald economy
body:
# 1vs1 - PvP Arena Plugin

A comprehensive 1v1 PvP arena plugin featuring a ranking system, spectator betting, and emerald-based economy.

## Features

### 1v1 PvP System
- **Queue System** - Players join a queue and wait for opponents
- **Entry Fee** - Pay emeralds to join (Rank × 10 emeralds)
- **Arena Teleport** - Auto teleport to designated arena points
- **Return System** - Players return to original location after match

### Battle Pass Ranking
- **Ranks 1-10** - Climb the ranks by winning
- **Rank Up** - Win to increase rank (unless rank gap ≥2)
- **Rank Down** - Lose to decrease rank
- **Persistent Data** - Ranks saved to file
- **Victory Rewards** - Higher ranks earn more emeralds

### Spectator Betting
- **Bet on Players** - Spectators can bet emeralds on fighters
- **Dynamic Odds** - Odds calculated based on rank difference
- **Auto Payout** - Winners receive rewards automatically

### Kit Chest System
- **Auto Reset** - Chests refill with preset items after each match
- **Preset Items** - Iron armor, shield, sword, and food
- **Two Chests** - One for each arena spawn point

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/pvp join` | Join queue | Everyone |
| `/pvp bet <player> <amount>` | Bet on fighter | Everyone |
| `/pvp list` | View queue | Everyone |
| `/pvp start` | Start match | OP |
| `/pvp stop` | Force stop | OP |
| `/pvp setrank <player> <rank>` | Set rank | OP |
| `/pvp setpoint1/2` | Set spawn points | OP |
| `/pvp setchest1/2` | Set kit chests | OP |
| `/pvp ranklist` | View all ranks | OP |

**Alias:** `/1v1`

## Setup
1. Place plugin in plugins folder
2. Set arena spawns: `/pvp setpoint1` and `/pvp setpoint2`
3. Place and set kit chests: `/pvp setchest1` and `/pvp setchest2`
4. Players join with `/pvp join`, start with `/pvp start`

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

## 日本語 (Japanese)

1vs1 PvP対戦プラグインです。

**対戦システム:** キューに参加して対戦相手を待つ。入場料はランク×10エメラルド。

**バトルパスランク:** ランク1〜10。勝利でランクアップ、敗北でランクダウン。

**賭けシステム:** 観戦者が選手にエメラルドを賭けられる。オッズはランク差で計算。

**装備チェスト:** 試合終了時にアリーナのチェストを自動リセット。

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/zYY55dzhjd
